prism-ai-lint — technical digest
===============================

Cut the tokens AI coding agents burn on every request: lint, repair and guard their configuration.

## Modules

.claude/hooks/format.py
examples/plugins/example_check.py — Example prism-ai-lint plugin.
prism-ai-lint.py
prism_ai_lint/__init__.py
prism_ai_lint/_engine.py
prism_ai_lint/_markup.py — Text helpers for Markdown instruction files: frontmatter, code spans, comments, @imports.
prism_ai_lint/_reference.py — Reference data: docs snapshot (2026-10), attribution patterns and scaffold templates.
prism_ai_lint/_runtime.py — Per-run state and base helpers shared by the engine and the checker modules.
prism_ai_lint/agent_aligner.py — Claude Code <-> Codex parity (--align): what one tool enforces or loads that the other does not.
prism_ai_lint/agent_contract.py — Lossless, source-aware project instruction representation.
prism_ai_lint/agent_converter.py — Read-only project contract conversion plans; never write critical files.
prism_ai_lint/agents_adapter.py — Neutral AGENTS project contract mapping.
prism_ai_lint/ape_checker.py — Instruction clarity (APE-style): hedging verbs and open-ended scope in agent instructions.
prism_ai_lint/ape_hook_checker.py — Checks on a repo's prompt-engineering hook (`.claude/ape/ape_hook.py`) and on UserPromptSubmit hooks that
prism_ai_lint/claude_adapter.py — Explicit Claude project instruction mapping.
prism_ai_lint/claude_files_checker.py — Checks on a repo's agent instruction files and its skill/subagent listing. Reports only.
prism_ai_lint/codex_adapter.py — Codex maps project instructions to AGENTS.md, with override precedence.
prism_ai_lint/codex_checker.py — Codex (OpenAI) configuration checks: config.toml, hooks, rules, custom agents, skills and AGENTS.md.
prism_ai_lint/codex_layer.py — A Codex configuration layer: the Codex home ($CODEX_HOME, ~/.codex) or a project .codex/ folder.
prism_ai_lint/codex_messages.py — Codex and Claude Code <-> Codex (--align) finding texts: hints and brief-report rows.
prism_ai_lint/codex_patch.py — Codex `apply_patch` envelopes: parse them and rebuild the edited file text, so the guard can
prism_ai_lint/codex_rules.py — Codex `.rules` files: `prefix_rule(...)` calls in Starlark, read statically and never executed.
prism_ai_lint/compression_checker.py — Compression layers checker: rtk, llmtrim and a routing gateway can compress the same traffic twice.
prism_ai_lint/config_flags.py — CLI defaults from the [flags] table of the policy file, limited to options that never write.
prism_ai_lint/content_validation.py — Human validation gates for critical content files.
prism_ai_lint/critical_content_policy.py — Critical content policy defaults.
prism_ai_lint/design_contract_checker.py — Optional `DESIGN.md` product design contracts: discovery, size, imports, local links and wiring.
prism_ai_lint/desktop_checker.py — Bounded, read-only desktop portability observations.
prism_ai_lint/env_checker.py — Checks for the `env` block and sandbox keys of a settings file.
prism_ai_lint/feedback_renderer.py — Machine-readable feedback contract for findings.
prism_ai_lint/finding.py — Finding model emitted by prism-ai-lint checks.
prism_ai_lint/git_runner.py — Small git command runner used by prism-ai-lint integrations.
prism_ai_lint/guard_checker.py — PreToolUse checks that block configuration loosening and unvalidated critical edits.
prism_ai_lint/guard_command.py — The prism-ai-lint guard as a hook command: recognise a plain call and build the canonical one.
prism_ai_lint/hook_checker.py — Hook configuration checks: events, matchers, handlers and hook scripts.
prism_ai_lint/hook_context_checker.py — Hooks that add context on every tool call or prompt, and hooks declared in two scopes (D-049).
prism_ai_lint/import_overlap_checker.py — INSTR_IMPORT_OVERLAP: lines an always-loaded instruction file repeats from a file it imports (D-048).
prism_ai_lint/instruction_checker.py — Instruction files, rules and auto memory: size, @imports, AGENTS.md wiring, rule frontmatter.
prism_ai_lint/issue_reporter.py — Anonymized issue report: unfixed findings rendered as Markdown for the public tracker.
prism_ai_lint/json_key_order.py — Keep a JSON file's sorted key order across repairs.
